pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal dark patches with rounded vertices and soft pixel-gradient transitions at the edges. The patches are densely clustered with high spatial occupancy relative to the light background.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways forming a topological web. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and the pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively uniform across the visible lateral flank.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, distinct avian-shaped silhouette is visible on the lower-right posterior flank, consistent with an oxpecker bird.
